{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.16

|arg= local

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Get an object's water filling.

|s1= [[getWaterFillPercentage]] obj

|p1= obj: [[Object]] - object to manipulate

|r1= [[Number]] - water level in range 0..1 (empty to full)

|x1= <sqf>
if (getWaterFillPercentage _myCar > 0) then
{
	hint "My feet are wet.";
};
</sqf>
